warnings: House title block: 'บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 2 (สำหรับผู้สูงอายุหรือคนพิการและคนทุกเพศทุกวัย)' — เลขที่แบบ AR 61141, กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง, series 'แบบบ้านสานฝัน ของขวัญปีใหม่ คนไทยมีความสุข', ลงวันที่ ม.ค. 2562. Single-story universal-design (accessible/elderly) house, 2 bedroom 1 bath. This is a DIFFERENT design within the same government series as house 27/บ้าน_ใหญ่_1ชั้น_04 ('บ้านครอบครัวไทยเป็นสุข 2', ม.บ.462120) — same cover template, different แบบเลขที่ and different structural system.

Notable structural feature: hybrid system. Footings/pedestals/pile caps are RC (S-02..S-11), but the wall-plate-level ring beam (S-04, 'แปลนคานระดับอะเส') and the entire roof frame (S-05, 'แปลนโครงหลังคา') are built ENTIRELY from light-gauge steel C-channels (⊏-200x100x4.2, ⊏-200x75x20x3.2 lipped, ⊏-100x50x20x3.2 lipped purlins/sag-rods, ⊏-125x65x6x8 rafters), with diagonal X-bracing and base plates (PL.200x200x6mm + 4-Ø6mm bolts) at each post. This is not a simple 'steel roof over RC beam' design (cf. house 27/04) — the entire superstructure above the RC pedestals is steel, more similar in spirit to บ้าน_ใหญ่_1ชั้น_01's hybrid note in the schema (§6a) though the specific system differs (there it was RC walls + steel roof only; here even the wall-plate ring beam is steel).

x-axis dummy grids: a local dimension row under grid row E (S-02, หน้า27) reads 1.50 then 3.50 (sum 5.00, matching the coarse 1-2 chain) — this places one dummy line at x=1.50 ('1\''). A SEPARATE local dimension at row A' (the dummy footing row, same sheet) reads 3.35 from grid 1 to footing C0,F4 — a second, different dummy position in the same 1-2 gap. Per the prime-ordering rule (scan left→right, first found = 1 prime) these are '1\'' (1.50) and '1\'\'' (3.35).

y-axis dummy grid: footings C0,F3/C0,F4/C0,F2/C0,F2 sit on their own row 1.50m below main grid A (S-02, หน้า27), confirmed by an explicit witness-line dimension distinct from the main E-D-C-B-A chain (4.00+2.50+4.00+2.50=13.00, cross-checked against the printed '13.00' outer bracket total — exact match, no mismatch on this house). Named 'A\'' per the above/left convention (main grid above it in reading order = A). No beam (B-mark) was found spanning to this row on S-03/S-04 — only footings/pedestals sit there; per §4 this does not disqualify it as a real grid line since footings are point elements that also need a resolvable grid_ref, independent of the beam-endpoint trigger.

z_levels are sparse for this house: op04 scope excludes the elevation/side_profile sheets (A-07/A-08 etc., architectural) where most level callouts would normally appear. Only two floor levels are printed on the structural sheets actually extracted in this pass, both on S-15 (หน้า40, ramp/stair-nosing detail): '+0.40' (upper ramp landing / main floor) and '+0.10' (lower landing near beam BA/B1). Both are unlabeled numeric levels (no Thai id text next to them) so id=null.

dimension_chains/unassigned_dimensions below are transcribed from the grid-bearing sheets actually in scope (S-02 plan_footing, S-03 plan_beam+slab, S-04 plan_beam ring-beam, S-05 plan_beam roof-frame) plus S-15's two level callouts — this is not an exhaustive sweep of every printed number across all 17 structural sheets (op04 scope), so section-only dimensions (e.g. individual footing/beam rebar-detail measurements on S-06..S-17) are captured in their own section files' element fields rather than duplicated here.
